projects.title: Libsys — Library Management System
projects.description: A comprehensive library management system built with Django (Python) for efficient resource tracking, automated book lending workflows (borrowing and returns), and membership loan tracking.
projects.outcome: Streamlined library inventory and borrowing workflows

projects.title: AI Credit Card Advisor
projects.description: An AI-powered conversational web application built with Flask and LangChain. Guides users through personal finance profiling questions to dynamically recommend best-fit credit cards based on spending habits, benefits, and credit score.
projects.outcome: Delivers personalized financial recommendations through conversational AI

projects.title: SIEM Monitoring & Logging Pipeline
projects.description: A comprehensive Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) pipeline. Orchestrates log ingestion from Windows and Linux systems using Splunk and Graylog. Automates security telemetry parses, event correlation (e.g., detecting brute-force attack IDs 4624/4625), and generates real-time dashboard visualization.
projects.outcome: Established automated host security monitoring and proactive threat detection

projects.title: Epic Games Free Game Auto-Fetcher
projects.description: An automated browser-automation bot built in Python utilizing Playwright. Automatically logs in, authenticates bypasses, checks the Epic Games Store weekly for free promotional titles, claims them, and dispatches automated success notifications via Telegram webhook.
projects.outcome: Automated promotional claim workflows with headless browser state preservation

projects.title: Hackerproof Personal Portfolio
projects.description: The source code for this personal portfolio website. Deployed statelessly to Google Cloud Run, featuring robust custom application rate-limiting decorators (django-ratelimit), sqlite DatabaseCache sharing across parallel Gunicorn workers, and optimized Google Analytics 4 tracking.
projects.outcome: Deployed an ultra-secure, highly scalable, and completely zero-idle-cost serverless web presence
